name: gamefound-vat
description: Browser extension that shows Gamefound reward and add-on prices including the VAT for your delivery country.

scripts.lint: bun run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.package: bun run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.firefox: bun run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist
